title: Add signed-wire end-to-end tests for authenticated SCHC ACK delivery
description: Correctness review found SCHC ACK unit/vector tests fabricate RxFrame and caller baselines, bypassing signature verification, replay commit, local binding, and authoritative baseline capture. Add an end-to-end test that signs wire frames, obtains the trusted envelope through LinkLayer.receive, feeds the production session API, and proves forgery/substitution/replay/wrong-local/prior-session rejection. Keep unsafe codec fixtures explicitly separate.
